name: radarr-2160p-database
description: Radarr profile Movies 2160p, taken from Dumpstarr and kept under that name. DTS-HD is allowed because the core track plays. TrueHD stays blocked except for trusted tiered groups, unless the name also shows a DD or DD+ track. A 14-40 GB Blu-ray encode from the mid-size groups scores with Dumpstarr's UHD tier 3, below hallowed and BHDStudio. Release names Radarr mis-parses still receive the group score. Minimum score 1000, upgrade until 10000.
